6.394 rsInvalidCellDataSetName
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidCellDataSetName is a critical error that occurs when an intersection scope specifies a
DataSetName (TablixCell.DataSetName, ChartDataPoint.DataSetName, or DataCell.DataSetName)
and both of the following conditions are true:
No Relationship exists between the intersection scope and an immediate containing scope.

No DefaultRelationship exists between the DataSet with the specified name and the DataSet of an

immediate containing scope.
